check: a 401 names the resource metadata; it names this server as where to sign in
the authorization server: sign-in, tokens, registration, PKCE (S256)
signed in as admin (the page sends the browser back with a code), then the tools
the tokens are sealed: neither names the user or can be read
a wrong password: the page again, saying so, and no code
a user who isn't an admin, with their right password: refused, saying only admins
refused: a forged form, a made-up sign-in link, an unregistered redirect, an http one
two-factor: without the code, the page asks for it
with the code: back to the app with a code and its state; EspoCRM's session ended
the code: not without its PKCE verifier; with it, tokens; only once
its token calls the tools; a refresh works once
no longer an admin in EspoCRM: the token is refused, and so is a refresh
